web_blocks.html: What Coforge Does: Coforge Limited (NSE: COFORGE, formerly NIIT Technologies) is a ₹95,037 Cr domain-led Indian IT services, BPM, and digital engineering firm [1, 11, 24]. It serves global clients in Banking & Financial Services (BFS), Insurance, Travel, and Healthcare/Hi-Tech. Following its May 2026 $2.35B Encora acquisition and Cigniti merger, the combined platform annualizes ~₹24,683 Cr in revenue (Q2 FY27: ₹6,170.8 Cr, +53.6% YoY) with a record $2.38 billion 12-month executable order book (+45% YoY) and a newly expanded Nuuron agentic cybersecurity suite (Nov 25, 2026) [5, 6, 8, 29].

book_paragraphs: Welcome to our refreshed institutional dossier on Coforge Limited. Before diving into ten years of financial forensics, customer case studies, and multi-timeframe charts, let us put our updated November 2026 conclusion directly on the table.

Coforge remains a high-execution, domain-led Indian IT services and digital engineering compounder. Under CEO Sudhir Singh, revenue grew from ₹2,372 Cr in FY15 to ₹20,380 Cr TTM through September 2026, while Q2 FY27 revenue reached ₹6,170.8 Cr (+53.6% YoY) alongside a $2.38 billion 12-month executable order book (+45% YoY) and upgraded 16.0% FY27 EBIT margin guidance. On November 25, 2026, Coforge also expanded its Nuuron agentic cybersecurity platform, ahead of its November 30 inclusion in the MSCI Global Standard / Emerging Markets Index.

On our verdict-stripped Pass 1 refresh audit, Coforge retained COMPOUNDER_PASS with kpi_health at PASS_WITH_WATCH—but our blind-spot check uncovered three material facts omitted from our November 16 baseline. First, Chairman O.P. Bhatt and NRC Chair D.K. Singh resigned abruptly in September 2026 after a KPMG board-evaluation audit, leaving Interim Chair Vivek Sharma in place through January 31, 2027 alongside Advent International and Warburg Pincus's ~21.8% post-Encora stake. Second, Q2 FY27 Total DSO stretched eight days sequentially to 110 days (net unbilled revenue up ₹500 Cr to ₹2,600 Cr) during Encora contract novations while Encora standalone revenue was flat QoQ (~$147–148M). Third, $10.2M in Q2 FX hedge losses taper to zero by FY28, and Coforge's ~55% US revenue mix plus LatAm hubs buffer higher US H-1B visa fees.

When we unlocked the November 23, 2026 verified tape, Coforge closed at ₹2,142.30 before pulling back 3.84% to ₹2,060.00 on the November 25 TradingView snapshot (40.43x TTM P/E—a 24.5% discount to Persistent Systems' 53.58x). Technically, the stock sits in a tighter 7.96% Bollinger-band Stage 2 VCP squeeze above a rising 30-week SMA (₹1,722.55).

Your portfolio position has also evolved: Zerodha now holds 41 shares at ₹2,041.80 average cost (₹87,834.30 value on Nov 23; +4.92% gain; 2.06% portfolio weight). We assign HOLD_WITH_HARD_STOP (0 shares sold), ratchet our structural stop UPWARD from ₹1,659.40 to ₹1,685.64, keep our Base target disciplined at ₹2,620.00, and maintain Tier-2 ACCUMULATE_ON_DIP strictly inside ₹1,951.99–₹2,036.18 (1.67:1 upper-support R:R; 2.03:1 midpoint R:R).

book_subsections.title: Summary of Key Numbers, Milestones & Risk Guardrails
paragraphs: Keep five updated anchors in view as you read ahead. First, Q2 FY27 revenue hit ₹6,170.8 Cr with a $2.38 billion NTM order book, 16.0% FY27 EBIT margin guidance, and 92% H1 FY27 FCF/PAT conversion. Second, post-Encora borrowings sit at ₹6,026 Cr (CRISIL AA+/Stable) while Q2 Total DSO stretched to 110 days—our #1 operational watch item.

Third, governance repair requires a clean permanent independent Chair by January 31, 2027 following the September 2026 exits of O.P. Bhatt and D.K. Singh. Fourth, at 40.43x TTM P/E, Coforge trades at a 24.5% discount to Persistent (53.58x) in a tight 7.96% BB-width Stage 2 VCP squeeze. Fifth, hold all 41 Zerodha shares with a ratcheted ₹1,685.64 structural stop, and add Tranche 2 strictly inside ₹1,951.99–₹2,036.18 toward ₹2,620.00.
